Name: Sinbad's Northern Fields
Author: Sinbad37
Description:
Northern Fields
There’s a little more wilderness beyond the Backwoods.
[b]Northern Fields[/b] is a new outdoor location designed to feel like a natural extension of the valley  a quiet, open area where you can explore, forage, fish, farm, or simply make the most of some extra space.
The area combines [b]meadows, sandy shores, freshwater and ocean[/b], with seasonal vegetation, forage, fishing spots, digging spots and plenty of room to build.
Features
[list]
[*]🌿 A fully playable outdoor location[/*]
[*]🌾 Farmable terrain [/*]
[*]🐟 Freshwater and ocean fishing[/*]
[*]🍂 Seasonal forage[/*]
[*]🐾 Space for animals[/*]
[*]🏡 Buildable using Stardew Valley's vanilla building system[/*]
[*]🚋 Minecart connection[/*]
[*]🌊 Waterfall and natural landscape features[/*]
[*]🌦️ Seasonal map visuals[/*]
[/list]Northern Fields is built to blend into the existing world rather than replace or overhaul it. It’s simply [b]another place to explore, work, fish, forage and build your own little corner of the valley.[/b]
This is the first release, and while the location is already fully playable, [b]feedback and suggestions are always welcome[/b].
Next update
Future updates may expand Northern Fields' integration with the surrounding world and give you even more ways to access and customize the area.
